creative_direction: Show Nami in a plain navy crew-neck top, with orange hair gathered loosely over one shoulder. Use warm ivory negative space to separate her face from the dark decorative ribbons behind her. Use flat graphic shapes with one contrasting accent and no dimensional glow. Use crimson patterned irises with visible pupils and highlights. Separate abstract black flame-shaped ribbons float behind the shoulders as decoration, touching or burning nothing and implying no attack. Create an original, nonviolent fan-art avatar, square 1024x1024. Center the character's head and shoulders within 70-75% of the frame, safe for a circular crop. Show both eyes clearly. No text, watermark, weapons, or copied anime composition.
